title: Expose quality inspection and sample attachment evidence
description: Extend the canonical ERP-061 attachment registry to the repository's authoritative quality-inspection and sample records. Preserve user-supplied reports and images as untrusted operational evidence without creating duplicate inspection, sample or storage masters. Do not infer quality approval, fetch third-party sources, render active content, configure production OSS, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation first audits the existing quality-inspection and sample entities and uses their authoritative persisted identifiers and existing workflows rather than matching order numbers, product text, filenames or remarks.

Authorized users can attach bounded PDF, PNG or JPEG evidence to existing non-deleted quality-inspection and sample records through ERP-061 services and the same signature, size, filename, digest and safe-download controls.

Inspection reports and sample images are labeled as user-recorded repository evidence and are never converted into automatic pass, fail, approval, certification, shipment authorization or supplier-performance decisions.

Direct metadata, history and download requests revalidate the authoritative parent record and its existing authentication and module authorization, preventing attachment identifiers from bypassing parent access.

Voiding preserves original ownership, metadata, digest and reason; hard deletion, silent replacement, cross-record reassignment and implicit sharing between inspection and sample records are not provided.
Missing or unavailable attachment evidence is shown as none or unavailable and is never interpreted as no defect, passed inspection, approved sample or completed report.
Lists expose bounded attachment summaries without per-row storage access, and legacy quality or sample records remain readable without request-time or production backfill.
Adding, reading or voiding evidence does not change inspection result, sample status, Product, supplier, customer, Sales Order, Purchase Order, inventory, shipment, invoice, tax or finance records.
Unsafe filenames and uploaded text are encoded as plain text; file content is downloaded rather than executed or embedded as active markup.

Unit/integration tests cover both parent types, invalid and unavailable parents, authorization, allowed and rejected content, void history, bounded summaries and adjacent-record non-mutation; safe validation passes and browser acceptance is recorded as deferred during development.

scenarios: Open an existing quality-inspection record and sample record, upload allowed report or image evidence, and verify each file remains linked only to its explicit parent without changing inspection or sample status.
Attempt an invalid parent and unsafe content, verify rejection, then void valid evidence and confirm history remains visible without being presented as an inspection pass or approved sample.

human_gate.reason: Repository-only attachment evidence using isolated non-production storage. Quality certification, external data access, production OSS or database changes, deployment and release remain behind mandatory human gates.
